verdicts.reason: The two candidates use almost the same broken leaderboard layout. In both, the RSVP CTA is shrunk into a pill the same size as the Free Entry, All Ages and Tastings tags, so the call to action is buried. Both also show a stray red-and-white missing-asset fragment after the pills. The date ('Saturday 21 June') sits in the centre column while its time and venue ('6:00 pm until sundown, Harbour Rooftop, Pier 9') are stranded at the far right, which splits the event details and breaks the reading order. The left column of copy is tiny and cramped. A's headline is weaker, and its can graphic almost touches the time text. B has a larger, more dominant headline and more room around the can, but its date is jammed right under the headline and its left-column type is even smaller.
